name: Row Masonry
description: Greedy dynamic row-by-row masonry balancer placing items into the shortest column with GPU translate3d positioning.

props.name: columns
props.label: Mobile Columns (<640px)
props.description: Base column count on mobile viewports (<640px).

props.name: columnsSm
props.label: Tablet Columns (640-768px)
props.description: Number of columns on small tablet viewports (≥640px).

props.name: columnsMd
props.label: Medium Tablet Columns (768-1024px)
props.description: Number of columns on medium tablet viewports (≥768px).

props.name: columnsLg
props.label: Desktop Columns (1024-1280px)
props.description: Number of columns on desktop viewports (≥1024px).

props.name: columnsXl
props.label: Ultra-wide Columns (≥1280px)
props.description: Number of columns on large screens (≥1280px).

props.name: gap
props.label: Gap (px)
props.description: Spacing between masonry columns and items.

react.description: Row Masonry — Clean Shadcn-style outer layer powered by @fleect/exhuma kinetic primitives.

nextjs.description: Row Masonry — Clean Shadcn-style outer layer powered by @fleect/exhuma kinetic primitives.

angular.description: Angular 18+ Standalone Row Masonry component with greedy column balancing.

solid.description: SolidJS Native Row Masonry layout component with fine-grained reactivity.

astro.description: Pure Native Astro Row Masonry component with greedy column balancing script.

blade.description: Laravel Blade component for Row Masonry with dynamic shortest-column layout.
blade.code:
@props([ 'columns' => 1, 'columnsSm' => 2, 'columnsMd' => 2, 'columnsLg' => 3, 'columnsXl' => 4, 'gap' => 16, ])
merge([ 'class' => 'exhuma-row-masonry relative w-full', ]) }} data-columns="{{ $columns }}" data-columns-sm="{{ $columnsSm }}" data-columns-md="{{ $columnsMd }}" data-columns-lg="{{ $columnsLg }}" data-columns-xl="{{ $columnsXl }}" data-gap="{{ $gap }}" > {{ $slot }}
